CREATE TABLE "public"."app_users" (
  "avatar_url" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "display_name" text,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "google_subject" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "last_login_at" timestamptz,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."business_invitations" (
  "accepted_at" timestamptz,
  "business_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "invited_by_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'STAFF' NOT NULL,
  "token_hash" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "business_invitations_role_check_6fc3012b" CHECK ("role" IN ('OWNER', 'MANAGER', 'STAFF'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."business_members" (
  "business_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'STAFF' NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("business_id", "user_id"),
  CONSTRAINT "business_members_role_check_6fc3012b" CHECK ("role" IN ('OWNER', 'MANAGER', 'STAFF')),
  CONSTRAINT "business_members_status_check_1527ac15" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."businesses" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "created_by_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "default_locale" text DEFAULT 'RW' NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "timezone" text DEFAULT 'Africa/Kigali' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "businesses_default_locale_check_2af4f63e" CHECK ("default_locale" IN ('RW', 'EN'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."locations" (
  "address" text,
  "business_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "default_worker_count" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "is_active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "join_code" text NOT NULL,
  "latitude" numeric,
  "longitude" numeric,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."notifications" (
  "attempt_count" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "channel" text DEFAULT 'SMS' NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dedupe_key" text NOT NULL,
  "delivered_at" timestamptz,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "language" text DEFAULT 'RW' NOT NULL,
  "last_error" text,
  "provider_message_id" text,
  "queue_entry_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "recipient" text NOT NULL,
  "sent_at" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "notifications_channel_check_51423196" CHECK ("channel" IN ('SMS')),
  CONSTRAINT "notifications_language_check_30625e09" CHECK ("language" IN ('RW', 'EN')),
  CONSTRAINT "notifications_status_check_3c607dd6" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'SENT', 'DELIVERED', 'FAILED')),
  CONSTRAINT "notifications_type_check_18243d78" CHECK ("type" IN ('QUEUE_JOINED', 'TURN_APPROACHING', 'TURN_READY', 'SIGNIFICANT_DELAY', 'QUEUE_CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."queue_entries" (
  "access_token_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "assigned_user_id" uuid,
  "cancelled_at" timestamptz,
  "customer_name" text NOT NULL,
  "customer_phone" text,
  "estimated_service_at" timestamptz,
  "expected_duration_minutes" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "joined_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "notified_at" timestamptz,
  "queue_session_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "service_finished_at" timestamptz,
  "service_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "service_started_at" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'WAITING' NOT NULL,
  "ticket_number" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "queue_entries_status_check_d67ff98e" CHECK ("status" IN ('WAITING', 'NOTIFIED', 'RETURNING', 'SERVING', 'COMPLETED', 'SKIPPED', 'NO_SHOW', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."queue_events" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "event_type" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "metadata" jsonb,
  "performed_by_id" uuid,
  "queue_entry_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "queue_events_event_type_check_35f5b7a3" CHECK ("event_type" IN ('JOINED', 'POSITION_CHANGED', 'ETA_RECALCULATED', 'NOTIFIED', 'MARKED_RETURNING', 'SERVICE_STARTED', 'SERVICE_COMPLETED', 'SKIPPED', 'MARKED_NO_SHOW', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."queue_sessions" (
  "business_date" date NOT NULL,
  "closed_at" timestamptz,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "location_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "next_ticket_number" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "opened_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "opened_by_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "paused_at" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'OPEN' NOT NULL,
  "worker_count" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "queue_sessions_status_check_a029234f" CHECK ("status" IN ('OPEN', 'PAUSED', 'CLOSED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."services" (
  "business_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "default_duration_minutes" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "is_active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "sort_order" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
